# The Straits Times
> Singapore’s leading English-language news site covering breaking news, analysis, opinion, and multimedia across Singapore, Asia, and the world.

The Straits Times publishes daily reporting and feature journalism spanning public policy, politics, business, sport, lifestyle, visual storytelling, podcasts, and special-interest sections. Its site is organized around major regional news desks and topic hubs, with search and multimedia access points for discovery.

## Core News Sections
- [Homepage](https://www.straitstimes.com/): Main front page for breaking news, top stories, and featured coverage.
- [Singapore](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore): Local news on politics, policy, transport, housing, education, and community issues.
- [Asia](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia): Regional reporting across Southeast Asia, East Asia, South Asia, and Asia-Pacific affairs.
- [World](https://www.straitstimes.com/world): International news covering geopolitics, conflicts, diplomacy, and global developments.
- [Breaking News](https://www.straitstimes.com/breaking-news): Fast-moving updates and latest headlines across major news categories.
- [Search](https://www.straitstimes.com/search): Site search for articles, topics, authors, and archived coverage.

## Singapore Coverage
- [Singapore](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore): Main local news desk for Singapore-focused reporting and developments.
- [Politics](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/politics): Coverage of government, elections, Parliament, and public policy in Singapore.
- [Courts & Crime](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/courts-crime): Reporting on criminal cases, court proceedings, and law enforcement matters.
- [Transport](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/transport): News on public transport, traffic, aviation, and mobility policy.
- [Housing](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/housing): Coverage of HDB, property policy, and residential market developments.
- [Education](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/education): News on schools, universities, exams, and education policy.
- [Health](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/health): Reporting on healthcare, public health, hospitals, and medical policy.

## Regional and Global News
- [Asia](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia): Regional headlines and analysis from across Asia.
- [South East Asia](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia): News from ASEAN countries and Southeast Asian regional affairs.
- [East Asia](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia): Coverage of China, Japan, Korea, and Northeast Asian developments.
- [South Asia](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia): Reporting on India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and neighboring countries.
- [Australia / New Zealand](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/australianz): News from Australia, New Zealand, and the wider region.
- [World](https://www.straitstimes.com/world): Main international desk for global reporting.
- [United States](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/united-states): US politics, economy, society, and foreign policy coverage.
- [Europe](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe): Reporting on European politics, security, and economic developments.
- [Middle East](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east): Coverage of conflicts, diplomacy, and regional developments in the Middle East.

## Business and Economy
- [Business](https://www.straitstimes.com/business): Main business section covering markets, companies, economy, and finance.
- [Economy](https://www.straitstimes.com/business/economy): Macroeconomic news, policy, inflation, trade, and growth reporting.
- [Companies & Markets](https://www.straitstimes.com/business/companies-markets): Corporate news, stock markets, earnings, and investment developments.
- [Banking](https://www.straitstimes.com/business/banking): Coverage of banks, regulation, lending, and financial services.
- [Property](https://www.straitstimes.com/business/property): Commercial and residential property market news and analysis.
- [Invest](https://www.straitstimes.com/business/invest): Personal investing, market trends, and portfolio-related reporting.
- [SME](https://www.straitstimes.com/business/sme): News and advice relevant to small and medium-sized enterprises.

## Opinion and Analysis
- [Opinion](https://www.straitstimes.com/opinion): Editorials, columns, commentary, and analysis on current affairs.
- [ST Editorial](https://www.straitstimes.com/opinion/st-editorial): The paper’s institutional editorials on major issues and policy questions.
- [Columns](https://www.straitstimes.com/opinion/columnists): Opinion pieces from regular columnists and contributing writers.
- [Forum](https://www.straitstimes.com/opinion/forum): Reader letters and public responses to issues in the news.
- [Videos of Opinion Content](https://www.straitstimes.com/opinion): Analysis-led commentary and explanatory journalism from the opinion desk.

## Life and Culture
- [Life](https://www.straitstimes.com/life): Lifestyle coverage spanning entertainment, food, travel, and culture.
- [Entertainment](https://www.straitstimes.com/life/entertainment): Film, television, music, celebrity, and arts news.
- [Food](https://www.straitstimes.com/life/food): Restaurant coverage, dining trends, recipes, and food culture stories.
- [Travel](https://www.straitstimes.com/life/travel): Destination features, travel news, and practical travel reporting.
- [Style](https://www.straitstimes.com/life/style): Fashion, beauty, design, and consumer lifestyle trends.
- [Books](https://www.straitstimes.com/life/books): Literary coverage, book reviews, and author interviews.
- [Arts](https://www.straitstimes.com/life/arts): Reporting on theatre, exhibitions, visual arts, and cultural events.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.straitstimes.com/sport): Main sports desk covering local and international competitions.
- [Football](https://www.straitstimes.com/sport/football): Football news, match reports, transfers, and tournament coverage.
- [Tennis](https://www.straitstimes.com/sport/tennis): Coverage of major tennis tours, players, and tournaments.
- [Golf](https://www.straitstimes.com/sport/golf): Golf reporting on tours, majors, and player developments.
- [Formula One](https://www.straitstimes.com/sport/formula-one): F1 race coverage, teams, drivers, and championship updates.
- [Schools](https://www.straitstimes.com/sport/schools): School sports coverage and youth competition reporting.

## Multimedia
- [Visual](https://www.straitstimes.com/visual): Visual journalism, photo essays, graphics, and interactive storytelling.
- [ST Podcasts](https://www.straitstimes.com/st-podcasts): Podcast hub for news analysis, interviews, and thematic audio series.
- [Videos](https://www.straitstimes.com/videos): Video reports, interviews, explainers, and on-the-ground footage.
- [Photos](https://www.straitstimes.com/multimedia/photos): Photo galleries and image-led coverage of major events.
- [Infographics](https://www.straitstimes.com/multimedia/graphics): Data visualizations and graphic explainers for complex stories.

## Special Content and Services
- [Paid Press Releases](https://www.straitstimes.com/paid-press-releases): Sponsored press release content published on the site.
- [SPH Rewards](https://rewards.sph.com.sg/): Membership rewards and perks platform linked from The Straits Times.
- [STClassifieds](https://www.stclassifieds.sg/?utm_source=Straits%20Times&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=ST_link_20131219): Classified listings marketplace for jobs, property, and other categories.
- [Advertise with Us](https://www.sph.com.sg/advertising-solutions): Advertising solutions and commercial partnership information from SPH.
- [FAQs](https://consumerfaq.sph.com.sg/kb?lang=en): Consumer help center for subscriptions, accounts, and support topics.

## Discovery and Access
- [Search](https://www.straitstimes.com/search): Search interface for finding stories, topics, and authors.
- [Singapore](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore): Entry point for local reporting and topic discovery.
- [Asia](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia): Entry point for regional reporting and country-specific coverage.
- [World](https://www.straitstimes.com/world): Entry point for international reporting and global affairs.
- [Business](https://www.straitstimes.com/business): Entry point for financial and economic coverage.
- [Opinion](https://www.straitstimes.com/opinion): Entry point for commentary, editorials, and reader views.
- [Life](https://www.straitstimes.com/life): Entry point for lifestyle, culture, and entertainment content.
- [Sport](https://www.straitstimes.com/sport): Entry point for sports news and event coverage.
